question: ___________hosts Sepak Takraw 2025 World Cup, 20 countries participating.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Bihar hosts Sepak Takraw 2025 World Cup, 20 countries participating.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Chief Minister Nitish Kumar** inaugurated the **ISTAF Sepak Takraw 2025 World Cup** in **Patna** this evening.

 
 
• 
 
Bihar is hosting the World Cup for the **first time**.

 
 
• 
 
**Twenty countries**, including **India**, are taking part in the six-day event.

 
 
• 
 
The World Cup will be held at the **Pataliputra Sports Complex Indoor Stadium** in **Kankarbagh**, Patna.

 
 
• 
 
A total of **150 matches** will be played, including **quad**, **regular**, **doubles**, and **mixed doubles**.

 
 
• 
 
**Sepak Takraw** has its roots in **South East Asia** but is becoming popular in other countries after its inclusion in the **Asian Games**.
